title: Iterative Research Refinement — meta-cognitive research process
description: Use this when you need to research a question, produce findings, audit your own process, and iteratively refine the methodology — not just the answer. A meta-cognitive research process (v9) that improves itself through nested feedback loops: Position Declaration, Iteration Manifest with quantified baselines and MANDATORY runtime metrics, Pre-Commitment, Observation Generalization, Loop 1 research, Loop 2 process audit, Loop 3 propose-to-new-file, Loop 3a fresh-subagent real-execution test with runtime measurement, Loop 3b commit, Loop 4 verification.
author: sox-ecosystem

task.description: The research question or process definition to iterate on

deltas.description: Measured improvement deltas (quality AND runtime metrics) from the iteration
